A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AutoDAN-Turbo and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to title-page metadata and small presentation edits in Section 3.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark, transferability, strategy-injection, and query-efficiency experiments in Section 4, Tables 1–5, and Figure 4, plus appendix examples.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and the appendix examples, including measured attack success rates, strategy counts, and query costs.

M1.justification: The attack loop, strategy-library construction, retrieval rules, and testing procedures in Sections 3.1–3.4 are unchanged. Removing enumeration markers and adjusting spacing does not alter the algorithm.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same HarmBench dataset, 50-request initialization dataset, and combined Unseen Malicious Requests dataset. Evaluation scenarios and appendix examples are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains GCG-T, PAIR, TAP, PAP-top5, and Rainbow Teaming. The broader comparator set in Table 2 and the PAIR/TAP efficiency comparison in Table 5 are also identical.

E3.justification: Section 4 retains identical model configurations, metrics, generation settings, and attack budgets, including zero temperature, 4096 output tokens, T=150, and the 8.5 termination threshold. Transfer and strategy-injection protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The model/dataset transfer analyses, external-strategy injection experiments, and query-efficiency analysis are identical. Appendices C–E retain the same strategy samples, exploration walkthrough, and comparative examples.

E5.justification: Neither version adds or revises repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices remain unchanged throughout the experiments and appendices.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains the 88.5 ASR on GPT-4-1106-turbo with the Llama-3-70B attacker, and Table 4 retains 93.4 after strategy injection.

T1.justification: The strategy definition, score-difference formulation, retrieval rules, and mathematical conditions in Section 3 are unchanged. Neither version introduces additional theoretical results or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about autonomous strategy discovery, black-box operation, transferability, compatibility with human-designed strategies, and attack performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of transferability, strategy combinations, and query efficiency are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same computational-demand limitation and mitigation through an existing strategy library.

D1.justification: Implementation settings in Section 4.1, hardware information in Appendix A, and full prompts in Appendix B are identical. Project and code links, including their embedded destinations, are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the bibliography, and the positioning against optimization-based and human-designed strategy-based attacks are unchanged. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 updates several author affiliation superscripts and the correspondence address. Section 3 removes stray or incomplete enumeration markers and adjusts punctuation and spacing; wording, section order, and narrative remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Small spacing and line-wrap changes occur on pages 3–4 and 6, including moving the first retrieval tactic marker to the next line. All figures, tables, captions, and appendix displays retain their content, structure, and placement.

improvement.justification: v3 updates author/contact metadata and slightly tidies Section 3's enumeration and spacing. These limited edits leave the scientific explanation, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations effectively unchanged; the experiments and appendices are identical.
